hints.title: Inclusion-Exclusion Divisibility Counting
hints.text: The count of integers up to x divisible by a or b is x // a plus x // b minus x // lcm(a, b).

hints.title: Monotonic Divisible Count Function
hints.text: As candidate value x grows, the count of magical numbers up to x increases monotonically.

hints.title: Range Shrinking Search
hints.text: Search between one and n times the minimum of a and b. Find the smallest x whose magical count reaches at least n, returning x modulo 10^9 + 7.

hints.title: See the blueprint

complexity.notes: Logarithmic elimination on the monotonic counting function using least common multiple.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Iterating up to the N-th magical number takes O(N) operations, which times out for N = 10^9.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Use inclusion-exclusion counting inside answer range reduction.
